title: SMB: Dissect additional reparse point buffers

commits_data.title: SMB: Dissect WSL symlink reparse point buffer
commits_data.message:
SMB: Dissect WSL symlink reparse point buffer

WSL symlink reparse point buffer in its first 32 bits contains
the WSL symlink layout version and rest of the buffer depends on
the version. Currently only versions 1 and 2 are used.

commits_data.title: SMB: Dissect WSL fifo/socket/block/char reparse point buffers
commits_data.message:
SMB: Dissect WSL fifo/socket/block/char reparse point buffers

These reparse point buffers are empty, so do not show dissector error for
them from the default switch case.
